rows: Octopuses and squid have one visual pigment, so the picture has no colour. A cuttlefish is colour blind too, with one opsin in its eyes.
An octopus resolves about 12 cycles per degree, and a squid about 6.6. Other records give lower figures, so the picture is set in the middle of these.
A squid's horizontal field runs about 300 degrees, and the records for hatchlings and juveniles run from about 250 to 320 degrees.
An octopus pupil is round in the dark and closes to a horizontal slit in bright light.
The strength of the streak, the blur, the gain, the falloff and the grey picture are the app's own settings, set inside the measured ranges.

claims.how: Set between the octopus value of 12.23 cycles per degree (R7) and the squid value of 6.56 (R6), with the app choosing 6.
